doc: Ambient walkers (round 8, feel pass): scripts/actors/ambient_walker.gd, instanced by the scene.json actor res://scenes/actors/AmbientWalkers.tscn. Variant sheets in walkers/ from tools/pixelgen/walkers_r8.py (same silhouettes as the source character, other clothes / hair). Owner: feel_r8. Schema: see the header of ambient_walker.gd. Station: open platform (walkable y 262..350): the walkers give way to the player (look-ahead 30 px, side step up to 14 px inside bounds, else they wait and after 3 s turn back), pass the speaking NPCs in front (y >= 318) and pause only away from them.
